step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard represents Blackboard's multi-account architecture managed by AWS Control Tower. On the left side of the vertical dashed divider, AWS Control Tower orchestrates AWS Organizations and AWS Service Catalog, indicated by physical arrows pointing from Control Tower to both services. On the right side, the diagram lists the four baseline security and governance services provisioned in each account: AWS Single Sign-On (modeled as IAM), AWS Config, AWS CloudTrail, and AWS IAM. These right-side services have visual focus arrows pointing to them but no connecting lines to other nodes, adhering strictly to the parsimonious model rules.
